Subject: Brightvale intake — notes, Q&A, and next steps (follow-up)

Elena / Marcus,

Thanks again for the call today. Below are the notes and a concise action list so we have alignment. Ive included the items we discussed as well as owners and expected delivery windows.

Meeting minutes (30 min):
- Attendees: Elena Ramos (Brightvale), Marcus Lee (Brightvale), Kimberly Park (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), David Kim (Redwood)
- Scope: CAIQ mapping review + evidence handoff cadence.

Key Q&A / clarifications:
1) Artifact transfer: Brightvale prefers a secure Drive folder (we discussed SFTP, but Brightvale will provide a short-lived Drive link). Marissa will send Redwood a prep checklist for Drive uploads.
2) Log samples: Redwood can provide redacted log examples for initial review. For full forensic samples Brightvale confirmed they will request a secured temporary export window. David to coordinate export format (JSONL vs gzipped syslog).
3) CAIQ mapping: Redwood uses a small set of custom mappings for model telemetry (fields: request_id, model_version, user_agent_details). Kimberly to share mapping notes and recommended answers for 12 CAIQ questions flagged by Brightvale.

Action items:
- Brightvale: Upload completed Brightvale_SIG_Template.xlsx to shared Drive and flag any rows needing vendor clarifications. (Owner: Elena) -- Due: 2027-03-12
- Redwood: Send CAIQ mapping notes and annotated answers for flagged questions. (Owner: Kimberly Park) -- Due: 2027-03-10
- Redwood Infra: Produce two redacted log samples (request traces & auth events) and confirm export format. (Owner: David Kim) -- Due: 2027-03-11
- Redwood CS: Share Drive prep checklist and the Zoom recording after the call. (Owner: Marissa Cole) -- Due: 2027-03-09

Attachments provided after call: brightvale-meeting-minutes-20270308.docx (meeting notes)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-brightvale (prep folder), HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/25641

If anything above needs correction, say so and Ill update the ticket. Otherwise well follow the action dates and touch base next week.

Thanks,
